atoms.a: The doorbell is always rung by Simone.
Jonathan calls his friend on Sundays.
The pen is only used by Mateo.
Jarett and Laurel are doing the laundry at the weekend.
The plastic bottles are always collected.
Robert is cleaning his car this month.
Her teeth are checked by the doctor twice a year.
